changelog: Added YouTube thumbnail ingestion engine with video title slugification to clean, lowercase, filesystem-safe slugs.
Added --youtube, --open-dir, and --download-only flags to jpg2pdf CLI.
Added 'Add YouTube URL(s)...' dialog, clipboard auto-detection, and background thumbnail worker to Desktop GUI.
Bypassed pypdf requirement for single-chunk image-to-PDF conversion with direct Pillow file copying.
Cleaned non-ASCII characters across engine and GUI to prevent Windows cp1252 UnicodeDecodeErrors.
